title: The Lamb
lead: Lambs were the everyday animal of Israel's sacrifices: the lamb God would provide (Genesis 22:8), the Passover lamb (Exodus 12), the daily offerings (Exodus 29:38–42), and the servant led like a lamb to slaughter (Isaiah 53:7). The New Testament calls Jesus "the Lamb of God" (John 1:29), and in Revelation the slain Lamb shares God's throne.
